_help: Config for the three Telegram bots. Each bot's token lives only in GitHub Secrets and is never committed here. Edit this file to change where/when/what each bot posts. See admin-help.html for the full walkthrough.

shared._calendarPhotosFolderUrlNote: Public Drive folder admins upload event photos to. Set this once, then paste the link into admin-help for a direct jump. Sharing MUST be set to 'Anyone with the link: Viewer' on the folder itself.

announcements.footer: — Posted automatically from our calendar. See the News page for full details.

bible._messageThreadIdNote: Leave null to post into the General topic. For a specific topic, use the middle number from https://t.me/<chat>/<threadId>/<messageId>.

todayChapterTopic._note: After each Mon-Fri post the Bible bot renames this topic to match the day's chapter. Bot must be admin with 'Manage Topics' permission.

saturday.bodyIntro: Join us in the Word, brought to you by Seed the Word Ministry.
saturday.bodyReview: We'll be reviewing what we have been reading throughout the week, catching up on missed discussions, diving deeper into God's Word.
saturday.bodyGoal: The goal is to promote critical thinking amongst the body of Jesus Christ, who are capable of discerning what is Scripture based and that of what is from the enemy.
saturday.bodyRulesNote: Please review the S.E.E.D. Rules for more information on recent changes.

playlist._worshipTopicNote: The Worship & Music topic where weekly digests post. Falls back to the Bible bot's messageThreadId if null.

audio._help: Bible Audio Pipeline config. Stage 1 (Apps Script poller) downloads voice memos posted to Telegram thread {telegramTopicId} into Drive folder rawDriveFolderId. Stage 2 (GitHub Actions) cleans them with ffmpeg and writes the result to cleanedDriveFolderId. Stage 3 (Apps Script notifier) emails the team when a cleaned MP3 is ready. Flip enabled to true only after both Drive folder IDs are set and the GDRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON GitHub Secret is in place. See admin-help.html#publish-a-new-podcast-episode for the full walkthrough.
audio._filterNote: RNNoise (cb.rnnn voice model) for ML-based speech denoising — aggressive on background noise without afftdn's watery artifacts. Followed by 80Hz high-pass for rumble, dynaudnorm for level matching across volunteers, and loudnorm to the Spotify -16 LUFS standard so every chapter sounds the same loudness. The /tmp/rnnoise-cb.rnnn path is downloaded by the bible-audio-cleanup workflow before ffmpeg runs.

layeredPlan._help: Layered Bible Reading Plan config. Read by THREE consumers: (1) assets/js/layered-plan.js, the browser renderer for community.html's Going Deeper row; (2) .github/scripts/post_daily_bible_to_telegram.py, the GitHub-Actions Mon-Fri Telegram footer; (3) dailyBibleBot() in docs/apps-script/order-handler.gs, the Apps Script port of the same Telegram footer. Editing any field here affects all three on the next run, no redeploy needed. Re-anchoring streams.otHistory.anchor or streams.poetryProphecy.anchor changes what chapter is delivered on a given date — do not adjust without intent.

prayer._note: Disabled May 12 2026 — the Bible bot now includes a Prayer & Thanksgiving block in its daily post to thread 1, so this separate nudge would double up. Re-enable by flipping enabled to true.

digest._help: Two-half pipeline: Poller every 15 min, Digest_Poster Mon/Thu/Sat 08:00 PT. The websiteSubmissionMarker MUST match prayer.intake.marker — these are one contract, edited together. summaryMaxChars=200 fits ~1-2 sentences; the rule-based summarizer prefers sentence boundaries and falls back to word-boundary then hard-truncate. summarizer='llm' calls Gemini 2.5 Flash via GEMINI_API_KEY; on missing key/API failure/safety trip it gracefully falls back to rule-based — the digest always renders. PrayerDrip emails (private to the submitter) deliberately stay rule-based and never call Gemini.

intake._help: marker MUST equal prayer.digest.websiteSubmissionMarker — these are one contract. endpointUrl reuses the existing Apps Script web app already used by orders / contact / stories. dripEnabled stays false until the Prayers + PrayerDrip Sheet tabs and PRAYER_INTAKE_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET are deployed (admin-help.html → Bot 6 deploy steps).
